question: What appearance and disruptive power are associated with the golden-hued form?
premises: The form has the splendor of molten gold.
It is a cause of agitation of cities and the like.
These attributes belong to the same form.
inference: The molten-gold form causes agitation of cities and similar effects.
plain_english: It has the splendor of molten gold and is the cause of the agitation of cities and so forth.
